$schemaDoc: Cloud STT model ids that are WEBSOCKET-ONLY: they exist in a tier's model list, but the pre-recorded /transcribe endpoint cannot serve them and returns HTTP 400. Every head keeps its own literal copy of this set because the catalog has no live-only field; this file is the single source those copies are tested against, so they cannot drift apart.
whyNotTheStreamingFlag: The per-model `streaming` flag in cloud-stt-catalog.json is NOT this set and must never be used as the filter. `streaming: true` means 'HyperWhisper Cloud routes this model live', and deepgramNova3 carries it on BOTH nova-3-general and nova-3-medical — its DEFAULT pre-recorded models. Filtering the dictation picker on that flag deletes Deepgram's default dictation model.
